consistency: Checkpoint-published file parts; verify complete bounded output after native FINISHED. No atomic multi-file table snapshot or external-producer exactly-once claim.
atomicity: Native sink/checkpoint protocol only; no transaction spanning unrelated systems.
idempotency: Up preserves an existing job and data. A new input run requires a fresh owned lifecycle or separately owned paths; failed data is not automatically reset.
delete_ttl: Lifecycle removes owned resources; retention and physical reclamation are not qualified.
durability: One kind cluster/VM and one SeaweedFS PVC. Retained process/Pod recovery is tested, not independent disks, backup, power loss or host failure.
retry: Native Flink fixed-delay task restart: 10 attempts, 10 seconds. S3 SDK uses explicit local endpoint/static lab credentials and bounded per-request connect/read timeouts. No host AWS discovery.
payload: 1,000,000 deterministic orders, 10,000 customers, expected 599,500,000 cents; three integer CSV fields.

fault_expectations.worker: Observe a completed checkpoint, delete one owned TaskManager Pod, require a native checkpoint restoration and exact eventual final result.
fault_expectations.storage_pressure: Four 64 MiB volume slots reject writes and can stall checkpoints while TCP readiness remains true. Preserve the stall and recover on the retained PVC; never claim its combined duration as worker-only RTO.

not_qualified: External ACK histories and live independent readers
